children: , the world's leading contract-chip producer, jumped approximately 1.7% to $435.24 Friday after reporting record August revenue of NT$514.81 billion. The stock's rebound put investors' attention squarely back on the relentless demand powering the AI-chip supply chain.

August sales climbed 53.3% from a year earlier and 10.1% from July's NT$467.58 billion. Revenue for the first eight months reached NT$3.387 trillion, up 39.3%, with August alone generating roughly 15.2% of that total. This is no gentle expansion. Advanced-chip production is accelerating at enormous scale.

TSMC also delivered a formidable 67.7% second-quarter gross margin, combining explosive growth with economics few AI-infrastructure suppliers can match. The chart shows the shares trading 33.35% above the $326.38 GF Value estimate, signaling that investors already expect exceptional execution. Record demand strengthens the growth story, but the premium leaves little room for overseas expansion costs or margin pressure to surprise.

title: TSMC Rebounds as August Sales Smash NT$500 Billion
